# S11 scenario catalogue (generated by tools/s11_scenario_catalogue.py; do not edit)

165 distinct S11 test scenario ids. Every scenario is synthetic and offline. Positive (SUPPORTED, human-reviewed, exported) and negative (abstaining, denied) paths are separate tests, so a deny-everything implementation fails. The 244 claim cases of the scientific evaluation are listed in evidence/s11_evaluation/.
